title: tttrlib conformance case file
description: One file per area. A malformed case fails fast here rather than as four confusing runner errors.

area.description: Groups the rows of the published coverage matrix.

id.description: Stable and unique across every case file; it is the matrix row key.

data.description: Data files, relative to the data root, substituted as $data0..$dataN. A missing file skips the case with a reason rather than failing it.

tmp.description: How many scratch file paths the case needs, substituted as $tmp0..$tmpN. Each runner makes its own; they are deleted afterwards.

expect.description: Binding name -> expected value. Generated by tools/conformance_update.py and reviewed as a diff.

tolerance.description: Binding name -> relative tolerance. Absent means exact equality, which for a floating-point value only makes sense when it is a bit-reproducible constant.

unsupported.description: Language -> why this case cannot run there. A declared gap; it shows in the matrix rather than failing.

throws.description: When true the step must raise; `as` is bound to whether it did. Use it to pin an error contract, which is a behaviour like any other.
